quotes.text: The cloud does not make you efficient. It only gives you the capability to be efficient if you have the discipline to manage it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Challenges the assumption that moving to the cloud automatically saves money.

quotes.text: Cost optimization is not a financial problem to be solved by accountants. It is a governance problem to be solved by architects.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes cloud cost as an architecture and governance responsibility.

quotes.text: Copilot doesn't fix a messy data architecture, it exposes it. It turns a quiet compliance risk into an active liability by making every forgotten file searchable and summarized.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why data hygiene must come before a Copilot rollout.

quotes.text: Licensing efficiency is a discipline, not a discount. You don't save money by begging for better rates during a renewal.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable rule for Microsoft 365 license right-sizing.

quotes.text: Governance is not the enemy of agility. It is actually the only foundation for predictable agility, allowing you to move fast without the fear of a total system collapse.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Counters the common belief that governance slows teams down.

chapters.title: Anatomy of waste: idle infrastructure, SaaS sprawl and shadow AI
Case studies: reserved instances, Power Platform and license right-sizing
Copilot governance and landing zone consolidation
Designing determinism: governance as control plane and FinOps metrics
Why governance becomes a competitive advantage

takeaways: Cloud waste is the default outcome of frictionless provisioning: idle resources, Power Platform and license sprawl, and ungoverned AI endpoints quietly consume budget.
Organizations that saved millions enforced governance first with Azure Policy, mandatory tagging, managed environments, landing zones and workload classification for reservations and savings plans.
Treat FinOps as a permanent discipline with the right metrics, right-size Microsoft 365 licenses by role, and clean up data before scaling Copilot with pilots and token quotas.
hook: Many enterprises move to Azure and Microsoft 365 and then face cloud bills nobody can explain. This episode is for architects, IT leaders and finance stakeholders and shows, through five case studies, how governance, FinOps discipline and consolidation turn an unmanaged cloud into a secure, cost-efficient environment.
